Independent review at b8bd1f402a85470034d84c6a26b351bdec2c70bb confirmed the complete approved source range is patch-equivalent and ordered, implementation bytes match the source closure, and fresh focused, architecture, portable, strict-Python, all-contract, and scoped task checks pass.
risks: The source lane's native Linux arm64 and physical Apple-silicon evidence applies to its exact approved closure; final artifacts still require target-native rebuild and acceptance from the eventual frozen source commit.
next_steps: Integrate only exact independently approved portable, Mac-native, and startup-profile closures supplied by the release coordinator, preserving source order and separate intermediate checkpoints.
